entities.short_title: Finiteness of terminal outcomes from finitely many roots
entities.description: Ordinary terminal outcomes of a dynamic solver lie among the roots of the projected vector field $\QTC$, so finiteness of $\mR(\QTC)$ yields finitely many reachable terminal outcomes. The appendix supplies the root containment underlying this proposition.

entities.short_title: Well-behaved projected dynamics
entities.description: The projected dynamics generated by $\vQ$ admit a unique maximal local flow $\vG$ with a lower semicontinuous lifetime $\tau$, continuous on the domain $D=\{(\vx,t):0\le t<\tau(\vx)\}$. The globally Lipschitz case corresponds to $\tau(\vx)=\infty$ for every $\vx\in X$.

entities.description: If $\vQ$ is globally Lipschitz on $X$, the projected dynamics generated by $\vQ$ admit a unique global flow $\vG:X\times[0,\infty)\to X$ that is continuous in $(\vx,t)$.

metadata.note: The proof observes that in the notation of Assumption 4.2 this global case is $\tau(\vx)=\infty$ for every $\vx\in X$.

entities.short_title: Exit time from the localization ball

entities.short_title: Agreement of localized flows before exit
entities.description: For $T<\sigma_{K_R}(\vx)$, the localized flow $\widehat{\vG}_{K_R}(\vx,\cdot)$ solves the original projected dynamics on $[0,T]$, and consequently $\widehat{\vG}_{K_R}(\vx,t)=\widehat{\vG}_{K_S}(\vx,t)$ on $[0,T]$ for every $S>R$.

entities.short_title: Maximality and uniqueness of the patched flow
entities.description: $\tau$ is the maximal existence time, and any local solution of the original projected dynamics agrees with $\vG$ on its interval of existence; hence $\vG$ is the unique maximal local solution map.

entities.short_title: Lower semicontinuous lifetime and continuous flow
entities.description: The maximal existence time $\tau$ is lower semicontinuous, each survival set $A_T=\{\vx\in X:\tau(\vx)>T\}$ being open, and the local flow $\vG$ is continuous on $D=\{(\vx,t):0\le t<\tau(\vx)\}$.

connects_to.description: Delivers the lower semicontinuous lifetime and continuity on the local-flow domain required by the assumption being verified.
Openness of each $A_n$ makes $A_\infty=\bigcap_n A_n$ Borel, and continuity of $\vG(\cdot,q)$ on $A_q$ makes each $\vx\mapsto G_i(\vx,q)$ continuous on $A_\infty$.

entities.short_title: Measurability of the dynamic solver
entities.description: The terminal map $g_{\vQ}:X\to X\sqcup\{\dagger\}$ is measurable, even though trajectories may fail to exist for all time or fail to converge; $X$ splits into Borel sets $C_1$ (finite lifetime), $C_2$ (infinite lifetime without convergence) and $C_3=\Xi$ (convergent), with $g_{\vQ}=\dagger$ on $C_1\cup C_2$ and $g_{\vQ}=L$ Borel on $C_3$.

entities.short_title: Closed discrete subsets of a compact set are finite
entities.description: If $S\subseteq Y$ is closed and discrete in a topological space $Y$ and $S\subseteq K$ for some compact $K\subseteq Y$, then $S$ is finite.

entities.short_title: Parametric transversality from a submersion
entities.description: For a $C^r$ map $\vF:P\times Z\to\R^n$ with $r>\max(\dim Z-n,0)$ that is a submersion, where $Z$ is a finite-dimensional $C^r$ manifold possibly with boundary and $P\cong\R^m$ carries Lebesgue measure $\lambda_P$, the fiber map $\vF_{\vp}$ satisfies $\vF_{\vp}\pitchfork 0$ for $\lambda_P$-a.e. $\vp\in P$.

metadata.method: Sard's theorem applied to the projection $\pi^M$ from $M=\vF^{-1}(0)$ onto $P$; regular values of $\pi^M$ are exactly the $\vp$ with $\vF_{\vp}\pitchfork 0$.
metadata.inline_tools: Rank-nullity applied to $D\pi^M$ and $D_z\vF$, whose equal kernels cancel on subtraction.

entities.short_title: Prevalence of discrete roots via a submersion probe
entities.description: Let $X$ have $C^2$ boundary, let $\mathcal Q$ be a complete metric vector space of $C^1$ maps $X\to\R^d$, and let $P\subset\mathcal Q$ be a finite-dimensional subspace. If $e^{\vQ}$ and $e^{\tilde{\vQ}}$ are $C^1$ submersions for every $\vQ\in\mathcal Q$, then for prevalent $\vQ\in\mathcal Q$ the set $\mR(\vQ)$ is discrete in $X$ and $\mR(\QTCP)$ is discrete in $\partial X$.

metadata.method: Fix a base $\vQ_0$, apply the parametric transversality lemma to each probe map, intersect the two full-measure sets in $P$, and quantify over all bases to obtain prevalence.

connects_to.description: Delivers the discreteness of $\mR(\vQ)$ and $\mR(\QTCP)$ for prevalent $\vQ$ that the finiteness argument starts from.

entities.short_title: Prevalently finitely many projected roots
entities.description: If $X$ satisfies the closed-convex assumption, $\mathcal Q$ satisfies the regularity and compact-containment assumption, and a finite-dimensional $P\subseteq\mathcal Q$ makes $e^{\vQ}$ and $e^{\tilde{\vQ}}$ $C^1$ submersions for every $\vQ\in\mathcal Q$, then for prevalent $\vQ\in\mathcal Q$ the field $\QTC$ has finitely many roots.

connects_to.description: Its hypotheses are exactly the proposition's, and it yields the finiteness of $\mR(\QTC)$ for prevalent $\vQ$.

entities.short_title: Bayes denominator bound on the shortfall posterior

entities.short_title: Moment bound from a near-one tail
entities.description: For $S\in[0,1]$ with law $W$ and $F(u):=W([1-u,1])$, every $\delta\in(0,1)$ and integer $n\ge 1$ give $\EE_W[S^n]\le n\int_0^\delta e^{-(n-1)u}F(u)\,du+(1-\delta)^n$.

metadata.inline_tools: Layer-cake representation $\EE[S^n]=\int_0^1\PP(S^n\ge t)\,dt$, the substitutions $t=u^n$ and $u=1-r$, and $(1-r)^{n-1}\le e^{-(n-1)r}$.

entities.short_title: Polynomial tail gives a polynomial moment rate
entities.description: If $F(u)\le Cu^{\gamma}$ on $(0,\delta]$ for constants $C,\gamma,\delta>0$, then there is $C'>0$ with $\EE_W[S^n]\le C'n^{-\gamma}$ for all large $n$.

metadata.inline_tools: Extension of the integral to $[0,\infty)$, the Gamma integral $\int_0^\infty e^{-(n-1)u}u^{\gamma}du=(n-1)^{-(\gamma+1)}\Gamma(\gamma+1)$, and $n/(n-1)^{\gamma+1}\le 2^{\gamma+1}n^{-\gamma}$ for $n\ge 2$.
